Initial release of cn-pdf-editor.

- Local PDF editor supporting text editing, image insertion, watermarking, annotations, merging, splitting, page reordering, and signatures.
- Powered by PyMuPDF; all processing occurs locally for enhanced privacy.
- Includes both web interface and command-line usage options.
- Suitable for document tweaking, watermarking, merging, and splitting.
